page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6t.2xlarge is an x86_64 server instance belonging to the Enhanced family, hosted on the KVM hypervisor. Compute capacity is supplied by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz, providing 8 dedicated vCPUs. The hardware configuration delivers 32.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB available per vCPU.

The instance does not include bundled local disk storage, requiring external network-attached volumes for all persistent data requirements. Networking specifications provide a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned. Graphics processing units and hardware accelerators are absent from the configuration.

Because computing capacity is backed by dedicated CPU cores rather than shared or burstable threads, resource allocation remains stable under sustained load. The balanced ratio of processing cores to memory capacity establishes a cost-effective operational profile for mid-tier application hosting, standard web serving, containerized workloads, and continuous integration runners.
